verses.21:46: وَلَئِن مَّسَّتۡهُمۡ نَفۡحَةࣱ مِّنۡ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ يَٰوَيۡلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ

meaning: The root "nfH" describes diffusion, like perfume spreading or wind blowing. It also refers to a vein spurting blood or a horse kicking. Figuratively, it means to give a gift or strike lightly.
